We booked Aoife to help train our 18 mth old Golden retriever. From the initial phone call consultation, Aoife really listended, put us at ease and provided useful information.

Aoife taught us different skills and techniques and provided detailed notes and videos. This has been a game changer for us and our dog.

I would highly recommend Aoife and will definitely reach out in future if needed again!

As first-time dog owners, we knew we’d need a bit of help getting started with the newest member of our family, our little Cavapoo, Alfie. Aoife was brilliant and gave us all the support and advice we needed to feel more confident. It made life so much easier, and Alfie has really grown and flourished since those early sessions. Thanks Aoife!

We got the Puppy Package with Aoife when we adopted Ernie and it was the best idea. We were definitely in training just as much as Ernie 😅 The 3 trainings were so helpful, Aoife covered everything from sleeping, toileting, feeding, tricks, and walking.
She was so patient, calm and kind to us (and Ernie!) Her expertise with dogs really shone through as any and every problem we presented, she had an answer or a suggestion.
I highly recommend Aoife for any new dog owners and we’ll be using her again as Ernie gets older.

Aoife is a real professional - knowledgeable, helpful and responsive to queries and questions. She made a real difference to our three-month old Labrador by training us as much as she trained him. Highly recommended.

Amazing service. We rescued our Ollie from a shelter. He came with a lot of behavioural issues. We found out through his training that this was down to being nervous and trauma experienced due to his rough start in life. Aoife was amazing as she worked with Ollie and us, as we began to realise how clever he is. Aoife gave us great training techniques to try and settle him that we will continue to implement.
She also provided nutritional information, chew toy advice as well as leash training and recommendations. Aoife has given us great insight on Ollie and on how to manage is triggers. Which we will continue to put into practice daily. Thanks a million we all really enjoyed working with you.

Aoife came to my job to provide exceptional training for our Practice Dog. Aoife was highly professional and gave us many easy to follow instructions and guidance. Aoife has such a wonderful presence and made me feel comfortable and confident after our session. Would highly recommend!

Aoife is an outstanding dog trainer. She has visited both my home and my office, providing excellent verbal and written guidance that has made a real difference. She is professional, highly knowledgeable, and an absolute pleasure to deal with. My dog loves her, and I always recommend her to others. I couldn’t be happier with the support and training we’ve received!

Aoife was a great help with our puppy I reached out when Luna was about 13 weeks old and I was tearing my hair out and crying near every day trying to manage a crazy sharky puppy. We where getting eaten left right and centre, couldn’t eat any food in peace without her jumping up and trying to rob our food and I could hardly get her to walk down the road without having to carry her half the way. Now Luna is 5 months old and with the help of Aoife Luna is a completely different puppy, no more shark attacks, we can eat in peace, chill on the couch in the evenings while she happily chews on her toys and even loves going on walks. I couldn’t thank Aoife enough for her help when she told me there was light at the end of the tunnel I first struggled to believe but now looking back and seeing how far Luna has come I fully believe it. We still train and are still learning day by day but Luna has definitely come a long way since the beginning.

Thanks to Aoife, Teddy is so much calmer,  more confident and we’re seeing less of his old reactive habits.   Aoife has given us simple yet effective techniques that have made all the difference, and she’s been so supportive throughout the process If you're looking for a trainer who truly understands dogs and works with them in the most gentle, effective way, Aoife is the one.
